subject: Sequencing plan and gated MAP for LuminaHealth MSA/DPA/order form
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: LuminaHealth Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sequencing plan and gated MAP for LuminaHealth MSA/DPA/order form

Hi Susan / Jason —

Thanks again for a productive call yesterday. As discussed, to keep the deal moving without overloading your legal team we propose a gated sequencing approach (MSA -> DPA -> order form) with a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on alignment checkpoints and evidence handoffs.

Attached is a first-draft MAP and a redlines checklist callout: Redwood_MAP_draft_vA.xlsx and a placeholder for your redlines (we can consolidate). High-level asks:
- Can your procurement/legal team confirm any non-standard data residency or audit requirements by Friday 12/17? (owner: LuminaHealth)
- Can we get Lumina’s DPA redlines in a single marked doc (Word) so we can triage vs. standard exceptions?
- Proposed target: sign MSA w/ core commercial terms by 12/29, finalize DPA by 01/12, and execute order form by 01/19, with a 2-week pilot activation window after order form.

Notes on gating:
- We can proceed with a commercial term sheet and sandbox access immediately; production access requires signed MSA + DPA.
- Where possible, we’ll provide evidence (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, KMS integration notes) ahead of DPA negotiation to shorten legal review cycles.

If that sequencing works, I’ll circulate a one-page MAP with owners and dates and slot a short weekly 15-min sync (Tuesday) for the next 3 weeks.

Thanks — aiming to keep momentum while minimizing long doc exchanges.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_draft_vA.xlsx (MAP draft, milestone owners), SPLA-acceptance-checklist.pdf (evidence list)
From: Susan Park <susan.park@luminahealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Jason Lee <jason.lee@luminahealth.com>
Cc: LuminaHealth Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequencing plan and gated MAP for LuminaHealth MSA/DPA/order form

Alex —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses:
1) Data residency: Lumina requires EU processing controls for PHI-derived datasets; we will flag those sections but nothing blocking for the initial sandbox.
2) We’re attaching a single Word doc with high-level DPA comments and a few proposed clause alternatives (see attached Lumina_MSADPA_redlines_v1.docx). We want to avoid re-negotiating standard liability caps where possible; I flagged three non-standard asks that will need internal sign-off.
3) Proposed internal timeline: our legal lead can aim for first-pass by 01/04; procurement wants commercial terms nailed by 12/29 as you suggested.

Two asks on our side: can Redwood provide a short attachment that maps your standard DPA clauses to the redlined items (one-page mapping table) and a SOC2 core evidence bundle (pdf) we can share with our auditors? If you can drop those into the Drive folder (link below), we’ll pull together our legal summary and aim to keep to your gating dates.

Regards,
Susan Park
Deputy General Counsel | LuminaHealth
susan.park@luminahealth.com

Attachments: Lumina_MSADPA_redlines_v1.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Susan Park <susan.park@luminahealth.com>, LuminaHealth Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequencing plan and gated MAP for LuminaHealth MSA/DPA/order form

Thanks, Susan — and thanks Alex for getting this started. Internal note / proposed sequencing and owners below (I’ll also add into the shared MAP spreadsheet):

MAP (proposed condensed milestones):
1) Commercial term sheet agreed (owner: Alex) — target 2026-12-29
   - Deliverable: one-page term sheet, list of required order form SKUs and billing cadence.
2) Evidence handoff & SOC2 bundle (owner: Neha) — target 2026-12-22
   - Deliverable: SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, encryption/KMS note, SLA excerpts.
3) DPA first-pass review (owner: Lumina legal; Redwood legal support: Karthik) — target 2027-01-04
   - Karthik: I’ll prepare a 1-page mapping of Redwood clause -> Lumina redline with recommended compromise language; this should reduce back-and-forth.
4) MSA signature (owner: Lumina signatory & Alex) — target 2026-12-29 (can be DocuSigned)
5) DPA final & order form execution (owner: procurement/finance) — DPA 2027-01-12; order form 2027-01-19

Contingency and acceleration options:
- If Lumina can expedite DPA redlines to 12/29, we can compress DPA to a 2-week cycle.
- For any stalled clause (PII handling, liability), Karthik will propose fallback language and an escalation to legal leadership for a decision within 3 business days.

Action items from Redwood by EOD 12/16:
- Neha: upload SOC2 evidence bundle + KMS note to Drive and flag any residual gaps.
- Karthik: draft the one-page mapping for Lumina redlines and circulate.
- Alex: produce the commercial term sheet and the one-page MAP with explicit owners/dates.

Susan / Jason — let me know if those owners and dates look reasonable from your side and if you want a weekly 15-min sync (Tuesdays 08:30 PT) or ad-hoc as needed.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Sequencing plan and gated MAP for LuminaHealth MSA/DPA/order form

Susan / Jason —

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround on redlines. We’ll execute the internal actions today:
- Neha will upload the SOC2 bundle and a short KMS integration note to the shared Drive by 17:30 PT.
- Karthik will post the clause mapping and recommended fallback language by EOD Monday 12/20.
- I’ll circulate the single-page commercial term sheet and the MAP (owners + dates) within 2 hours.

Operational notes:
- For the pilot activation (post-order form) we recommend a very limited production pilot (single workspace, 100k tokens/day cap) to validate data flows and latency. We’ll include a rollback plan in the MAP so procurement can sign off on a risk-limited activation.
- If Lumina wants earlier access to a private preview of the onboarding console, we can enable sandbox credentials tied to the term sheet without legal gating.

Next steps: confirm weekly 15-min sync or leave ad-hoc. I’ll put a tentative calendar hold for Tuesdays 08:30 PT starting 12/21 and you can accept or decline.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this tight.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
